npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30720-01.html.text: Magister Kaiena: What is going on? If it is nothing important, do not disturb me.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30720-02.html.text: Magister Kaiena: What is it? This had better be urgent; I am a very busy woman.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30720-05.html.text: Magister Kaiena: I am sick of Magister Gauen's lies... Someday, he will get what he deserves...

Q00337_AudienceWithTheLandDragon/30720-0.text: Magister Kaiena: Great job! With that kind of strength you may even have a 1% chance of survival! Even if you don't kill Antharas at least you can delay his complete awakening. I would tell you to run away if the battle takes a turn for the worse, but Antharas' Lair is fashioned in such a way that …

Magister Kaiena: Did Gabrielle send you? Well, in that case I won't waste your time with a long explanation. You must go to the Forsaken Plains and kill marsh stalkers and marsh drakes . You must be able to defeat them if you intend to even meet the guardians of Antharas at the entrance of Dragon V…

Magister Kaiena: I hope you realize that this Mark of Watchman does not qualify you to undertake an expedition against Antharas. You must go and meet the other guardians of whom Gabrielle spoke and collect their marks of watchman.

Magister Kaiena: Ah, the expedition starts to take shape! I hope everyone has written their wills! Ha! I am looking urgently for the people that Gabrielle has already recognized. Could it be that they survived? You must go and see Gabrielle now.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30720-03.html.text: Magister Kaiena: Ha! Gauen had the gall to say such things!? It is he who wished to keep the Giants' research documents. His greed and duplicity are almost unbelievable... He pretends to be an honorable man, but the real Gauen is a mystery. I swear that what we did, we did to prevent the documents …

links.text: "If Gauen is guilty, we must report his misdeeds to the authorities of the Ivory Tower."

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30720-04.html.text: Magister Kaiena: Uh...yes, well...you see... As you know, that would force us to reveal the fact that Beleth was able to penetrate the Tower in disguise in the first place. That is the kind of embarassment that might escalate into a thorny political problem between Giran and the Ivory Tower. I'm su…

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30720-note.text: Magister Kaiena: Ha, you must be crazy! You don't know the difference between an Elf and a Dark Elf, or a Human and an Orc! I'll bet you don't even know the difference between a Fighter and a Mystic! Do you know how to read? Or can you see the word 'Magister' written right here? Why are you botheri…

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30720.html.text: Magister Kaiena: Should I let this one live or not? Ah, I was just talking to myself. Why are you here? Grand Magister Fairen has a terrible headache, so bother him at your peril. Like him, I hate to be bothered because of trivialities...

In order to use this system, you must have completed your 3rd class transfer, which means you must be level 76 or above. In addition, 1 Holy Pomander is required to learn each skill. If …

links.text: Cleanse the pomander to reset your skills.
Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/learn-lowl.text: In order to use the Skill Transfer system, you must be level 76 or higher and have completed your 3rd class transfer.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/cleanse-no.text: Do you really want to reset your transfer skills? You must use all your Holy Pomanders in order to use this service. After all, 10 million adena is a huge sum of money. Use the rest of your pomanders, then try your request again. Do not fret. I will make sure that all of the Holy Pomanders you used…
To reset the skill link requires 10 million Adena. In addition, your class must corresponding to the skill.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
